values.heading: ADU Building Permit Submittal Checklist
values.text: Case ADU-26-0803 submittal must include a dimensioned dwelling floor plan, light and ventilation calculations, emergency-egress clear-opening dimensions, smoke and carbon monoxide alarm layout, utility connection plan, bathroom exhaust route, and parking/access statement.

values.title: ADU permit document checklist updated
values.body: The permit case checklist now specifies drawings, light/ventilation, egress, alarm, utility and parking/access evidence.
